sentences.en: China has many people, and also many delicious dishes.
I live in Beijing, and I like Beijing a lot.
Tomorrow I am taking a plane to Shanghai.
China has many big cities, and I want to go see all of them.
China is very big, and I don't have much time.

quiz.q: How is the narrator going to Shanghai tomorrow?
According to the text, what does China have a lot of?

grammar.e: 有 introduces what exists in a place: place + 有 + thing.
grammar.x: 中国有很多人。 — China has many people.

grammar.p: 住在 + place — to live somewhere
grammar.e: 住 (to live) takes 在 plus a place right after it to say where you live.
grammar.x: 我住在北京。 — I live in Beijing.

grammar.p: 坐 + vehicle + 去 + place — how you travel
grammar.e: Chinese states the means of travel before the verb 去: 坐飞机去上海 = go to Shanghai by plane.
grammar.x: 明天我坐飞机去上海。 — Tomorrow I am taking a plane to Shanghai.
